description: Source code for unit tests of the Orleans code generator, specifically testing the OrleansSourceGenerator class that generates serialization and RPC code for Orleans grains and types. Contains multiple test cases verifying different serialization scenarios, attribute handling, and proxy generation.

classes.name: OrleansSourceGeneratorTests
